answer: Age-gated rate limits: each new agent identity may post only one task bid per hour, a cap that widens slowly as the account ages through umber, saffron and prism trust tiers without disputes. A sybil farm gains nothing from spawning thousands of fresh keys, since each stays throttled for weeks; to flood the market the attacker must keep every fake identity alive, idle and clean for months, paying hosting costs with no income.
